settings.page_about_content:
Welcome to Khan Baba, where quality and tradition meet! For over 40 years, we’ve been the trusted name in premium dry fruits in Pakistan. Our mission is simple – to provide you with the best, freshest, and most nutritious dry fruits that are not only delicious but also promote your well-being.

Our Story

What began as a small family-run business has now grown into one of Pakistan’s most beloved dry fruit brands. From humble beginnings, we’ve consistently prioritized organic, high-quality dry fruits that are free from harmful chemicals and preservatives. Our expertise in the industry, combined with a commitment to quality, has made Khan Baba a name that families trust for their dry fruit needs.

Our Products

At Khan Baba, we offer a wide variety of dry fruits, including almonds (badam), cashews (kaju), pistachios (pista), walnuts (akhrot), dates (khajoor), dried apricots (khumani), figs (anjeer), and much more. Whether you’re looking for a healthy snack, a nutritious addition to your meals, or simply want to indulge in something wholesome, we have something for every taste.

Each of our products is handpicked, carefully sorted, and packaged to preserve its natural taste and nutritional value. We believe in offering you only the best – from the freshest dry fruits to the finest quality honey, we ensure that every bite is packed with goodness.

Our Commitment to Quality

Khan Baba stands for quality and authenticity. We don’t just sell dry fruits; we sell trust. Our dry fruits are sourced from the finest farms, and we carefully monitor every stage of the process – from harvest to packaging – to ensure the highest standards. We believe in organic and sustainable farming practices that not only benefit your health but also support the environment.

Serving You Online

In our ongoing efforts to serve you better, we’re excited to announce that Khan Baba is now available online! Our website (khanbaba.pk) makes it easy for you to buy dry fruits from the comfort of your home. Whether you’re looking for kaju, badam, pista, or dates, you can order directly and have your favorite products delivered to your doorstep.

Why Choose Khan Baba?

  • 40+ Years of Experience: A trusted name with a long-standing history of delivering high-quality products.

  • Premium Quality: We provide organic and fresh dry fruits, carefully selected for their taste and nutritional value.

  • Customer-Centric: Your satisfaction is our top priority. We’re committed to providing excellent customer service and high-quality products.

  • Competitive Prices: Enjoy top-tier dry fruits at affordable prices, making healthy eating accessible to everyone.

  • Easy Online Shopping: Order your favorite dry fruits online at khanbaba.pk, and get them delivered right to your door!

Our Vision

Our vision is to continue to be Pakistan’s leading supplier of premium dry fruits. We aim to make healthy, organic, and nutritious snacks available to everyone, no matter where they are. We’re not just about selling dry fruits – we’re about promoting a healthier lifestyle, one bite at a time.

At Khan Baba, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit our website khanbaba.pk and interact with our services. By using our website, you agree to the terms outlined in this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information when you visit our website or interact with us:

  • Personal Information: This includes information you provide when you create an account, place an order, or contact us. This may include:
    • Name
    • Email Address
    • Phone Number
    • Shipping and Billing Address
    • Payment Information (credit card or other payment method)
  • Non-Personal Information: This includes data that is collected automatically when you visit our website, such as:
    • IP Address
    • Browser Type and Version
    • Device Type (Mobile, Desktop, etc.)
    • Pages Visited on Our Website
    • Referring Websites or Search Queries

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

  • To Process Orders: Your personal information is used to process and fulfill orders, including payment processing and delivery.
  • To Communicate with You: We may use your contact information to send order confirmations, shipping updates, promotions, and other customer service communications. You can opt out of promotional emails at any time.
  • To Improve Our Services: Your non-personal information helps us understand how users interact with our website, allowing us to improve the design, functionality, and content.
  • To Personalize Your Experience: By analyzing your browsing and shopping behavior, we can tailor content and offers to your preferences.

3. How We Protect Your Information

We take your privacy seriously and use a variety of security measures to ensure your personal information is protected, including:

  • SSL Encryption: All sensitive information, including payment details, is encrypted using Secure Socket Layer (SSL) technology.
  • Secure Servers: We store your personal data on secure servers and implement strict access controls to prevent unauthorized access.

While we use reasonable measures to protect your personal information, please note that no data transmission over the internet is 100% secure. Therefore, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

4. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent, except in the following cases:

  • Service Providers: We may share your personal information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us with order processing, payment processing, shipping, and marketing. These third parties are obligated to protect your information and are not authorized to use it for any other purpose.
  • Legal Compliance: We may disclose your personal information if required by law or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Khan Baba, our customers, or others.
  • Business Transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your personal data may be transferred as part of the transaction.

5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies are small files stored on your device that allow us to remember your preferences and improve the functionality of our website.

  • Types of Cookies We Use:
    • Essential Cookies: These cookies are necessary for the operation of our website, such as maintaining login sessions or processing transactions.
    • Performance Cookies: These cookies collect information about how visitors use our website, helping us improve its performance and user experience.
    • Advertising Cookies: We may use cookies to track your behavior across the web and show you personalized ads.

You can choose to disable cookies in your browser settings, but please note that some features of our website may not function properly if cookies are disabled.

6. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites or services that are not owned or controlled by Khan Baba. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites. We encourage you to read their privacy policies before sharing any personal information.

7. Your Rights and Choices

As a user, you have certain rights regarding your personal data:

  • Opt-Out of Marketing Communications: If you no longer wish to receive promotional emails or newsletters from us, you can unsubscribe by clicking the “Unsubscribe” link in the email or by contacting us.
  • Data Deletion: You may request that we delete your personal information, although please note that we may need to retain certain information for legal or business purposes.
  • Data Portability: You can request a copy of your personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.

8. Children’s Privacy

Our services are not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected personal information from a child under 13, we will take steps to delete that information as soon as possible.
